def main():
    import sys
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    arr = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    arr.sort()
    median_index = (n - 1) // 2
    print(arr[median_index])
